fieldValues.chose: Closed the cycle 2026-10-28 11:30 to 2026-10-29 11:30 UTC. Three group PRs merged by the owner, all owner-merge, so no delegated budget used: srs-web#630 (read a local folder's files concurrently; reviewer approved, mandate none, non-normative), srs-rust#1472 (session AttentionState: reviewer findings none, all gates green after the schema mirror landed; mandate remedy 800f223f affirmed, charter 384a704a) and srs-web#635 (inline tick or deny; reviewer verdict reject because its ruling names remedy 2910ac1e, which exists only in Suggestions and has no fork in Affirmed). srs-web#636 (conversations view, same remedy 2910ac1e, reviewer reject) was merged by the owner at 11:36 UTC, just after the close, and belongs to the next cycle. No decision awaited assent, so no group session was held. No new escalation record: the reviewer already escalated the unaffirmed remedy on the PRs and the owner merged both.
fieldValues.rationale: No new escalation. The one open question, whether remedy 2910ac1e is to be affirmed (a human fork into Affirmed), is the owner's act and cannot be made by an agent; the owner merged both PRs that cite it, so it is repeated as an inform item rather than filed as a second record. The earlier inform item (who files the essay package change in muDemocracy.org after ruling 5d5feb79) is still unclaimed.
